known.title: Roadmap key FORGE-LIVE-1 already belongs to another story

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Plan gap. This spec assigns FORGE-LIVE-1 to live notes, but `plans/roadmap.json:130-132` already assigns that key to the live-app adoption story. `src/forge/records.py:325-328` refuses `forge roadmap add live-notes` when a key belongs to another spec, so the proof-list claim that this item was added is false and the live-notes work cannot enter the roadmap under this key.
